categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Wallet label and modifications to DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp for PSBT signing.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where FillPSBT fails to complete signatures on owned inputs when witness_utxo and non_witness_utxo disagree. As noted in the description, 'FillPSBT loaded keys for the witness_utxo script while SignPSBTInput signed the non_witness_utxo spend', causing confusing signing failures during PSBT workflows.
